operations.title: Logical backup (gbak)

fields.label: Backup filename on the Firebird server
Ordered backup volumes

columns.label: Capacity in bytes (empty for last volume)

fields.help: Add at least two distinct server filenames in order. Set the byte capacity of every volume except the last; leave the last capacity empty. Moving a volume also moves its capacity. Paths refer to the Firebird server, not this browser.

options.label: Convert external tables to internal tables

fields.label: Skip data for tables matching
fields.help: Native Firebird case-insensitive SIMILAR TO pattern: % matches any sequence and _ one character; backslash escapes pattern characters. Skip takes precedence over include. Table metadata is retained.

fields.label: Include data for tables matching
fields.help: Native Firebird SIMILAR TO pattern, not a Python regular expression. May be combined with skip: data must match include and must not match skip. Metadata-only mode excludes all data regardless of either filter.

operations.title: Logical restore (gbak)

fields.label: Backup filename on the Firebird server
Additional backup volumes in order
fields.help: For split backups, add every remaining volume after the first backup filename, in original backup order.

fields.label: Restored database filename on the Firebird server
Primary database file allocation (pages)
fields.help: The primary filename above stays fixed. Firebird reserves at least 255 pages in this file even if a smaller allocation is requested. Allocations are pages, not bytes.

fields.label: Secondary database files in order
fields.help: These are database storage files, not backup volumes. Add distinct server-side filenames. Moving a file also moves its page allocation. Leave the final file allocation empty; all earlier files need a positive allocation.

fields.label: Skip data for tables matching
fields.help: Native Firebird case-insensitive SIMILAR TO pattern: % matches any sequence and _ one character; backslash escapes pattern characters. Skip takes precedence over include. Table metadata is retained.

fields.label: Include data for tables matching
fields.help: Native Firebird SIMILAR TO pattern, not a Python regular expression. May be combined with skip: data must match include and must not match skip. Metadata-only mode excludes all data regardless of either filter.

fields.label: Key-holder plugin
fields.help: Installed on the Firebird server; supplies the key material needed to read the backup and encrypt the restored database.

fields.label: Encryption key name
fields.help: Selects the restored database's key; leave empty to inherit the backup header's key name. The key holder must supply both the backup key and any new destination key. Native gbak inserts this name into an SQL KEY clause without quoting. Restore errors can leave a partial destination database.

fields.label: Restored database encryption plugin
fields.help: Leave empty to inherit the backup header's plugin. An override selects the restored database's plugin, not the plugin used to read the backup. Both plugins must be installed on the Firebird server.

operations.title: Physical backup (nbackup)

fields.label: Physical backup filename on the Firebird server
fields.help: Physical backup requires a writable database. Use logical backup for a read-only database.

fields.label: Incremental backup level
fields.help: 0 creates a full backup. A positive level requires the preceding level in backup history. Restore the complete chain in order.

fields.label: Database backup GUID (overrides level)
fields.help: Enter a hyphenated UUID, with or without braces. The native request always uses braces so it cannot be mistaken for a backup level.

fields.label: Backup read I/O policy
fields.help: Default: ON on Windows servers, OFF elsewhere. Direct reads require filesystem support.

fields.label: Clean backup history after backup
fields.help: Removes native backup-history records, not backup files. Older level/GUID lookup may no longer be possible; keep an independently verified restore chain.

fields.label: Keep backup history by
fields.help: Pruning can remove level/GUID lookup records. Backup files are kept.

operations.title: Repair database (gfix)

options.label: Mend for backup (may discard damaged records)
Full check, no update, ignore checksums (preset)

fields.label: Native validation modifiers
fields.help: These modifiers only affect validation or mend. ODS upgrade rejects them; ICU and shadow cleanup do not apply them. Presets retain their stated modifiers; selecting additional modifiers does not remove preset flags. Mend implies full validation and does not guarantee data recovery. Preserve a recoverable backup before changing database structures.

fields.label: ICU parallel workers requested
fields.help: Only applies to the ICU action. Leave blank to use native defaults. Zero omits the native worker DPB setting; positive requests are limited by Firebird MaxParallelWorkers. This does not report how many workers actually ran.

fields.label: Do not linger after this maintenance task
fields.help: Requests native gfix -nolinger for this attachment. Does not permanently change the database LINGER setting or disconnect other active sessions. Effects can occur before a later native error.

operations.title: Activate a database shadow

fields.label: First shadow filename
fields.help: This promotes the first shadow file into an independent database in place. Stop or isolate the original database before recovery; do not operate both copies as the same database. The target must be an active shadow, not the original database or a secondary shadow file. Native header verification is performed immediately before activation, but cannot prevent another server administrator replacing a file. Coordinate exclusive control of the recovery files. Firebird 5.0.4 may activate a shadow before rejecting insufficient utility privileges. An authorization error is not proof that the shadow is unchanged: inspect its native header before any further recovery attempt.

fields.label: Repeat the shadow filename
fields.help: Repeat the exact recovery target above, not the original database filename.

fields.label: The original database is stopped or isolated
fields.help: This promotes the first shadow file into an independent database in place. Stop or isolate the original database before recovery; do not operate both copies as the same database. The target must be an active shadow, not the original database or a secondary shadow file. Native header verification is performed immediately before activation, but cannot prevent another server administrator replacing a file. Coordinate exclusive control of the recovery files. Firebird 5.0.4 may activate a shadow before rejecting insufficient utility privileges. operations.title: Set current generator value

fields.label: Current generator value
fields.help: SET GENERATOR sets the current value, not the next value. Signed 64-bit integer. Other attachments may consume values concurrently. Ordinary consumption of committed sequences is not reclaimed by row rollback. Pending sequence DDL can use transaction-local values. Current-value assignment and next-value restart are different native operations; commit the task before treating restarted values as globally published.
